target_customer: Renewable energy and data center developers
problem: Developers start projects without deep zoning and interconnection diligence; the launch post says roughly 80% of such projects never get built.
business_model: B2B SaaS plus expert services and reports
product_category: Site selection and due diligence software for energy projects

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating fragmented GIS, zoning and grid data is laborious; AI agents were added later.

defensibility.rationale: Cleaned national data sets and expert validation are costly to rebuild.

market_need_then: Launch post cites about $17B of cancelled clean energy projects a year and expensive diligence data.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand; short real word name, crowded with unrelated Pace results.

pivots.from: Green project siting and due diligence
pivots.to: AI agents, software and services for power and data center deployment
pivots.why: Current site and YC description reflect data center focus; timing not stated

outcome_analysis: Paces focused on siting and diligence for clean energy projects and expanded into data center power. It raised an $11M Series A in July 2024 led by Navitas Capital and now has a team of about 48, which suggests solid product demand riding the energy and data center buildout.
notes: Series A stated by ESG Today, Built Worlds and pv magazine. Profiles claim $13M to $14M total, implying earlier seed funding not itemized; unverified. No dated competitor named in the launch post, company site or the Series A article, and none found near 2022, so the list is empty.
